name: W Hong Kong
positioning: A W hotel above Kowloon Station in West Kowloon, designed around an enchanted forest theme, with a 76th-floor rooftop pool and a harbor-view spa
best_for: Travelers who want easy Airport Express access and a sky-high pool with harbor views
Business travelers and shoppers based in West Kowloon

facts.text: Use of the heat and water area is included with spa services other than nail care and waxing.
Rooms and suites were designed by g+a and Glamorous in eight different styles.
Rooms have views of the cityscape, harbor or waterfront.
In the suites, all bathrooms get natural light and two-thirds have harbor views.
The hotel is near Kowloon Station, with easy access to the Airport Express and mainland China.
The hotel is connected to the Elements mall.
Reception is on the sixth floor, reached by a glass bubble lift with glimpses of the shipping port.
The WET Deck has a mosaic mural behind its lounge chairs and views of the harbor.
KITCHEN serves an international buffet with handmade dim sum, sushi and seafood.

highlights.text: WET, the rooftop pool on the 76th floor, has panoramic city and harbor views.
The hotel was designed by two firms around an enchanted forest theme.
The glass lobby has oversized insect sculptures, tree trunk-like columns and rows of LED twig lights.
Bliss Spa has couple suites and treatment rooms overlooking the harbor.
The 73rd-floor heat and water area has a harbor-view vitality pool, an aroma steam room and a dry sauna.

considerations.text: Conde Nast Traveler says travelers focused on sightseeing in Tsim Sha Tsui, Central or the outlying islands may find the neighborhood overly commercial.
The restaurants are popular with locals, so communal areas often mix guests and neighborhood residents.
